Clean pseudo-spectra for many features (main batch entry)

Source: R/spectral_filtering.R
clean_pseudo_spectra.Rd

Runs process_pseudo_spec() and filter_fn for every target, reading the per-sample parquets in file_directory through DuckDB. This is the work behind the filter and finalize stages.

Usage

clean_pseudo_spectra(
  targets,
  file_directory,
  fd = NULL,
  con = NULL,
  grouper = ppm_upgma(ppm = 30),
  buffer = 50L,
  fdr_thresh = 0.01,
  cor_thresh = 0.3,
  min_count = 10L,
  group_statistics_fn = NULL,
  filter_fn = NULL,
  consensus_mz_fn = NULL,
  apex_source = c("recompute", "upstream"),
  window_mode = c("buffer", "fwhm"),
  require_rt = FALSE,
  batch_idx = NULL,
  n_batches = 1L,
  report = TRUE,
  report_path = "pseudo_specs_report.pdf",
  mgf_dir = NULL,
  fetch_chunk_size = 50L,
  progress = TRUE
)

Arguments

targets

Character vector of feature ids.

file_directory

Directory with the per-sample parquets.

fd

Optional table with mzmed and rtmed (or mz/rt), with rownames or a feature_id column matching targets. Without it the precursor m/z comes from the parquets and RT is unknown.

con

Optional open connection from setup_connection(); it is left open.

grouper

A grouper closure (grouper-contract).

buffer

Passed to process_pseudo_spec().

fdr_thresh, cor_thresh

Used only to build the default filter_fn.

min_count

Used only to build the default group_statistics_fn.

group_statistics_fn

A statistics closure (stats-contract); NULL uses correlation_statistics(min_count).

filter_fn

A filter closure (filter-contract); NULL uses correlation_filtering(cor_thresh, fdr_thresh).

consensus_mz_fn, apex_source, window_mode

Passed to process_pseudo_spec().

require_rt

If TRUE, a target without RT in fd is a "MissingTargetInfo" error. The target-list route sets this.

batch_idx, n_batches

Process only slice batch_idx (1-based) of targets split into n_batches contiguous chunks. A slice past the end returns an empty table.

report, report_path

Write diagnostic plots per feature to a PDF (needs ggplot2). On by default; the process_*() functions turn it off.

mgf_dir

If set, also write one MGF file per feature here.

fetch_chunk_size

Features per DuckDB query.

progress

Show a progress bar.

Value

data.table with one row per kept fragment: mz_g2 and mz (both the consensus fragment m/z), grouped_mz (group id), total_intensity (mean per-cell intensity, not a sum), n_samples, count, r, t_stat, p_value, fdr, feature_id, deconv_error (NA on real rows). Column names are what export_mgf() reads.

Details

Every target gives either fragment rows or exactly one error row with deconv_error set to:

  • "MissingTargetInfo": no precursor m/z (or no RT when require_rt = TRUE).

  • "MissingMs1Signal": no pointer rows for the target, or no pointer parquets at all.

  • "NoAssociatedFragments": no group survived statistics or filtering, or process_pseudo_spec() raised an error (errors are not shown).
